# Cue 0.2.0 — Traditional Chinese and new artwork / 正體中文與全新圖示
## English
Cue now supports Traditional Chinese throughout its interface, with new app artwork and a fix that brings Settings into focus immediately.
- **English and Traditional Chinese:** all settings, menus, launcher prompts, commands, and Cue's status/error messages are translated. The default is **Follow System**. Choose **Settings → Language → App language** to select **English** or **正體中文**, then reopen Cue to apply the change. - **Application names stay familiar:** Cue keeps its name, and installed application names continue to follow macOS. Cue's language preference changes its own interface only. - **New artwork:** the blue app icon appears in Finder and **About Cue**. The menu bar uses a matching symbol that adapts to light and dark appearances, with a small dot when an update is available. - **Command+, opens and focuses Settings:** invoking Settings from the launcher brings it to the front and gives it keyboard focus, including when the window was already open or minimized. - **Responsiveness stays central:** translations are cached outside the typing path, and artwork is prepared in advance. Language support adds no artificial waits to typing or keyboard navigation.
Validated with 43 optimized core tests, localization and language-preference checks, and manual Release-build checks of both interfaces and Settings focus. Existing shortcuts and other preferences are preserved.
### Install or upgrade
[Download Cue 0.2.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.2.0/Cue-0.2.0-universal.dmg) · [Checksums](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.2.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
- **From 0.1.1:** choose **Check for Updates…** in Cue's menu or **Command+, → Updates**, then follow the download, installation, and relaunch prompts. - **From 0.1.0:** install 0.2.0 manually once; there is no need to install 0.1.1 first. Quit Cue, open the DMG, drag Cue into **Applications**, replace the old copy, and reopen Cue. Version 0.1.0 has no updater; later updates can be installed from within Cue. - **First installation:** open the DMG, drag Cue into **Applications**, and launch it there. Cue appears in the menu bar without a Dock icon; **Option+Space** is the default shortcut.
Keep Cue in a writable installed location. It cannot update itself while running directly from the read-only DMG; macOS may request authorization if installation needs additional permissions. Automatic update checks can be disabled in Settings, and you choose when to download, install, and relaunch.
The universal build targets **macOS 14 or later** and includes Apple silicon (`arm64`) and Intel (`x86_64`) code. Runtime testing is on **Apple silicon with macOS 26.6.2**; Intel and other macOS versions remain unverified. Cue is ad hoc-signed and **not Apple-notarized**. Sparkle's signed updates do not replace Developer ID signing or Apple's first-launch checks. Follow the app-specific approval steps in the [installation guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.2.0/docs/installation.md) if macOS blocks the first launch.
## 正體中文
Cue 現在完整支援正體中文介面，換上新的 App 圖示，並修正設定視窗無法立即取得焦點的問題。
- **英文與正體中文介面：**所有設定、選單、啟動器提示、指令，以及 Cue 的狀態與錯誤訊息都已翻譯。預設為**跟隨系統**；可到**設定 → 語言 → App 語言**選擇 **English** 或**正體中文**，重新開啟 Cue 後生效。 - **保留熟悉的 App 名稱：**Cue 的名稱不變，已安裝的應用程式名稱仍依 macOS 顯示。Cue 的語言設定只改變自己的介面。 - **全新圖示：**Finder 與**關於 Cue**視窗使用藍色 App 圖示。選單列使用相同風格的符號，配合淺色與深色外觀；有可用更新時會加上小圓點。 - **Command+, 開啟設定並取得焦點：**從啟動器叫出設定時，視窗會移到最前面並取得鍵盤焦點，原本已開啟或最小化的視窗也適用。 - **維持即時回應：**翻譯在打字流程之外快取，圖片也事先處理完成。語言支援不會在打字或鍵盤操作中加入人為等待。
已通過 43 項最佳化建置的核心測試、翻譯與語言偏好檢查，並以 Release 建置實際檢查兩種語言介面及設定視窗焦點。原有快速鍵與其他設定會保留。
### 安裝或升級
[下載 Cue 0.2.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.2.0/Cue-0.2.0-universal.dmg) · [檢查碼](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.2.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
- **目前使用 0.1.1：**從 Cue 選單選擇 **Check for Updates…**，或按 **Command+, → Updates**，再依提示下載、安裝並重新啟動。 - **目前使用 0.1.0：**請直接手動安裝 0.2.0 一次，不必先安裝 0.1.1。退出 Cue、開啟 DMG，將 Cue 拖進**應用程式**並取代舊版本，再重新開啟。0.1.0 沒有更新器；之後即可從 Cue 內更新。 - **首次安裝：**開啟 DMG，將 Cue 拖進**應用程式**，再從該位置開啟。Cue 會出現在選單列，不顯示 Dock 圖示；預設快速鍵為 **Option+Space**。
請從已安裝且可寫入的位置執行 Cue。直接從唯讀 DMG 執行無法自我更新；安裝若需要額外權限，macOS 可能要求授權。自動檢查更新可在設定中關閉，下載、安裝與重新啟動的時機都由你決定。
通用版的最低建置目標為 **macOS 14**，包含 Apple silicon（`arm64`）與 Intel（`x86_64`）程式碼。目前僅在 **Apple silicon、macOS 26.6.2** 實際執行測試；Intel 與其他 macOS 版本仍待驗證。Cue 只有 ad hoc 簽章，**尚未經 Apple 公證**；Sparkle 的更新簽章不會取代 Developer ID 或 Apple 的首次開啟檢查。若 macOS 阻擋首次開啟，請依[安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.2.0/docs/installation.md)完成針對 Cue 的授權步驟。
